items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1955-07-26
items.q: I have asked some of my friends like uh Miss Diana Schuh yes and the great Mr. Ben Crosby and the great Mr. Frank Sinatra and well I think they're all gonna help me cause they all love me

ctx.x: and speaking of recording people say that you have to be in the mood to sing that you can't turn your talent off and on at will is this true well that's the way it is with me well then when you record if you're not in the mood to sing what happens to the recording day just a flop record one you don't like anyway I know uh... I've been told that you have plans to build a school with the money that you're earning and we want to find out about that school and we'll do that right after this message now for the first…

could you tell us about it well it's not exactly a school it would be a religious center oh a religious center yeah with the school combined uh huh to teach what for instance uh well as I would like to say in singing I have had contact with so many different people and uh some have been very much perplexed and confused and uh I have found that uh they have told me rather that my singing has been of some type of help to them uh when they were low in spirit that they found that the songs did so much for them but uh…

it sounds like a marvelous idea you know Louis Armstrong has uh sort of proved that jazz is really an international language uh do you think your spirituals for instance could move a Russian audience?
